findings.title: ForTenant ignores tenantID
findings.detail: ForTenant returns the whole package-level invoices slice regardless of the tenantID argument, so a caller for one tenant sees every tenant's invoices.
findings.risk_rationale: One tenant can read another tenant's billing data.

findings.title: Summarize leaks tenant data across the shared slice
findings.detail: Summarize ranges over the package-level invoices slice, which holds every tenant's invoices.
findings.risk_rationale: Summarize's log line could include another tenant's counts.

summary: Both ForTenant and Summarize touch the shared invoices slice without filtering.
